evidence_quotes.O: The first thing you notice about the FujiFilm XF1 is the cool retro look. The camera looks like should be 50 years old
evidence_quotes.C: Before buying this you have to decide on what it is you actually want. For me it was the tablet feature.
evidence_quotes.E: A KVM switch is useful if you have multiple computers taking up space like I do, especially if one of your computers is running as a server
evidence_quotes.A: I'm actually writing this review using this iLuv workstation so please excuse any typos that may happen.
evidence_quotes.N: The other major annoying feature is that when you turn the TV on, all your other remotes are rendered useless for about 2 minutes.
